query:
WITH
            pos_tags AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT t.id AS tag_id
                FROM tags t
                WHERE t.name ILIKE '%' || $1::TEXT || '%'
            ),
            post_match AS (
                SELECT tp.post_id
                FROM tag_posts tp
                JOIN pos_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = tp.tag_id
            )
            SELECT p.id, p.title
            FROM post_match pm
            JOIN posts p ON p.id = pm.post_id
            LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3;
